title: Ritter
description: A medieval hardcore Fabric mod featuring a permanent vitality system, synchronized PvP combat, and real consequences. Every hit matters, every death counts, and every decision shapes your fate. (Formerly a plugin — now a full Fabric mod.)
body:
🔥 Important Project Update
Knight has officially transitioned from a Spigot/Paper plugin to a full Fabric mod.
This change was necessary to support advanced features such as client‑side HUDs, networking, custom items, synchronized combat systems, and a modern vitality framework.
The old plugin is now discontinued and has been removed.
Knight is no longer a plugin — it is a Fabric mod that must be installed on both server and client.

⚔️ Overview
Knight is a medieval‑themed hardcore Fabric mod that introduces a high‑stakes vitality system, synchronized PvP combat mechanics, and permanent consequences. Every decision matters, every fight has weight, and survival becomes a tactical challenge.
The mod is designed for competitive worlds, hardcore SMPs, medieval servers, and any environment where death should have real meaning.

✨ Core Features
❤️ Vitality System
- Each player has 0–5 vitality points
- Every death removes 1 vitality
- At 0 vitality, the player is permanently eliminated
- Vitality persists across restarts and cannot be bypassed
- Automatic revival when vitality is restored
⚔️ Advanced Combat System
A fully server‑synchronized PvP system:
- Every hit adds +30 seconds of combat time (stacking)
- Combat timer is identical for both players
- Actionbar displays the remaining combat time
- Combat ends instantly when a player dies or logs out
- Combat‑logout or combat‑death → lose 1 vitality
- Anti‑combat‑abuse:
- No combat from fire, lava, fall damage, mobs, explosions, ender pearls, snowballs, fishing rods, etc.
- Combat starts only from real PvP damage
🛡 Combat Restrictions
- Tridents with Riptide or Channeling are banned during combat
- Ender pearls are limited to 64 per combat
- Violations are blocked instantly
📊 HUD & Display
- Clean actionbar HUD for combat
- Vitality sync on join and respawn
- Fully client‑side compatible
🧙 Admin Tools
- Revive eliminated players
- Modify vitality
- Full control over player state
🧱 Mod Content
- Custom items
- Custom blocks
- Custom creative tabs
- Fabric networking
- Full client‑server integration

📥 Installation
Knight is now a Fabric mod, not a plugin.
Required on Server:
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Knight Mod
Required on Client:
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Knight Mod
Without the client mod, HUD, vitality sync, and items will not work.

📌 Notes
The previous Spigot/Paper plugin is no longer supported and has been removed.
Knight will continue to expand with new HUD elements, boss bars, sound effects, and additional medieval mechanics.
